<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to deprotecting a TBS group, i.e., breaking a t-butyldimethylsilyl group and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break the "t-butyldimethylsilyl" group and form "aliphatic hydroxyls". Then we can retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES and template ID from the result. This will give us the precursors when applied to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
